picks.headline: Audiotool 3.0 opens browser DAW with NEXUS SDK and MCP AI
picks.rationale: Browser DAW opening an SDK with MCP means producers can wire their own LLMs into the workflow — directly changes how music makers can build and automate their setup tomorrow.
picks.excerpt: Audiotool 3.0 rebuilds the browser-based multiplayer DAW as an open platform via a new SDK called NEXUS, which lets creators build custom instruments/plugins and supports AI integrations through MCP so producers can connect their own LLMs to the workflow.

picks.headline: Eldoraudio's free ML tool converts guitar recordings to MIDI
picks.rationale: Free ML guitar-to-MIDI transcription in the browser is an immediately usable workflow win for producers who want editable MIDI from live guitar takes.
picks.excerpt: Eldoraudio launched a free browser-based tool that uses a note-detection model to convert guitar recordings into editable MIDI files — upload audio, set the BPM, and get a MIDI transcription ready to drop into a DAW, with a dedicated model for distorted/overdriven guitar planned.
